notes: NOT ESTABLISHED (4): Latin Securities (Uruguay) - its own site is robots-disallowed and no opened source stated a street address or city; Montevideo is likely but unverified, so nothing is given. Baker Tilly Moldova (operates as Baker Tilly Klitou and Partners SRL, part of Baker Tilly South East Europe) - neither its Moldova page nor its contact page states a physical address; job ads refer to a 'Chisinau office' but no credible source opened states a head office. MIG LLC (Mongolia) - no company of that name could be identified at all; not established. BPM Mongolia LLC - likewise, no identifiable company record; not established. RENAMINGS / MERGERS worth knowing: Kaupthing Bank's domestic operations were refounded as Arion Bank (Arion banki hf.) in Reykjavik - head office given is Arion Bank's. Societe Generale Albania was sold to OTP and renamed OTP Bank Albania in April 2019; the Tirana head office (Twin Towers, Deshmoret e Kombit Blvd) is the same building. APICORP MOVED its head office from Dammam, Saudi Arabia to Riyadh (announced 2023); if the record predates the move the correct city is Dammam - flagged in its note. Nepal Investment Bank merged with Mega Bank in 2023 to become Nepal Investment Mega Bank; head office remains Durbar Marg, Kathmandu. Investrust Bank Plc was taken into possession by the Bank of Zambia in April 2024 and delisted in July 2025; head office was in Lusaka. United National Bank Limited is the legal name of the UK bank that trades as UBL UK; registered office 2 Brook Street, London. ProCredit Holding AG (Frankfurt) and JSC ProCredit Bank Georgia (Tbilisi) are given separately, group and subsidiary. Ecobank is given as TWO entries: the group (Ecobank Transnational Incorporated, Lome) and Ecobank Kenya Limited (Nairobi) - for a Kenyan central bank official who was a non-executive director of 'Ecobank', Ecobank Kenya is the more likely referent but the source does not say, so both are supplied. Swedbank AB's registered seat (kommunsate) is Stockholm while its head-office building is at Landsvagen 40 in Sundbyberg, in greater Stockholm; Stockholm is given. The three Armenian banks' addresses come from a third-party directory page (RepatArmenia) that labels them 'Address' rather than 'head office'; all three are in Yerevan. Arab African International Bank's HQ is from BankTrack's bank profile, not the bank's own site (aaib.com serves no readable contact text). CBZ, Investrust, State Bank of Mongolia, Banco de Bogota, Banco AV Villas, Islami Bank Bangladesh, Nepal Investment and BPC are sourced from Wikipedia infobox/body statements because official pages could not be retrieved; cities for all of these are consistent and uncontroversial.
